reviews.t: Durable makeup case with plenty of room for everyday makeup stuff.

Different compartments are nice, I do wish I could fit more in the smaller top part but it's nice for 1 larger pallets or a few smaller palletes or mirror. Overall great for my everyday and then some makeup.

reviews.t: Easy to carry train case during travel and can hold my favorite eye shadow

This was a very beautiful case, I have a new MacBook Air 13 inches, this case is just as big as it is, which is exactly what I need. it is easy to carry during travel and can hold my favorite eye shadow.

Bought this as a Christmas present for my daughter who’s away in college. Do not buy...it was torn, missing a zipper, and had pieces missing. reviews.t: Good bag, but a little bulky
reviews.x: I like this case overall, but I am disappointed with how bulky it becomes once you put makeup supplies in it. I did not over fill the case or it's compartments. I used about the same amount of makeup shown in the product's description, and it was still buldging and a little difficult to zip close. It was a good purchase for the cost though.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the case's spaciousness and ample compartments for organizing makeup.
Many customers describe the case as sturdy, well-made, and high quality.
Several reviewers report zipper failures or breakage, calling the case poorly made or not durable.
Some customers report defects such as unglued dividers or a strong unpleasant smell.
Reviewers value the case for travel and gifting, citing its portability and usefulness as a present.
